blocks.p: In Hard mode there are 60 Vaettir in the south-east of {area:546}, and a Monk with 55 Health takes next to no damage from them: {skill:245} caps each hit at 10% of your Health (about 5), and the Assassin's {skill:826} takes 5 off every hit. Meanwhile three Smiting spells burn them all down at once.

The run from {area:650} is made once. After each clear, step out through the portal to {area:482} and straight back in. So come with plenty of free inventory space, as you won't be back in town for a while.

builds.name: 55hp Vaettir farmer
gear: A superior rune on every armor piece: 105 Health
The −50 Health Grim Cesta (from Cities of Ascalon): 55 Health

blocks.note: Smiting above 11 is wasted: {skill:826} caps your damage at 21.

ol: Leave {area:650} and run through {area:482} to {area:546}. The way can be run without aggroing anything, and a Birthday Cupcake's speed boost is handy for it.
On arriving in {area:546}, take the Norn Hunting Party bounty at the resurrection shrine if your {page:?title=41|Norn} title isn't maxed yet.
Before aggroing: {skill:245}, then {skill:572}, then {skill:826}, in that order so {skill:826}'s damage reduction counts. Recast them in the same order before {skill:826} ends.
Aggro the groups on the north side, and wait for them to ball around you.

When they're all hitting you: {skill:2232} first, then {skill:272}, {skill:247} and {skill:1113}. Recast them as they recharge until all the Vaettir are dead: how often depends on how often the Standard's faster recharge comes up.
Don't start a 2-second cast when {skill:826} is about to recharge: the window to recast it is short.
Then do the same with the groups on the south side.
Pick up the drops, step out to {area:482} and back in for another round.

ul: Event items, while an event is on.
Glacial Stones, for the Glacial Gauntlets or for salvaging into Dust.
Also dyes, lockpicks, Bird's Eye Compasses and Stalker's Rations.
